about: Evaluator calibration (STYLE_GUIDE.md §6). Shipped strings by name; seeded violations are shipped strings or slots with one planted break each.

lines.text: A write-off? The player did this. Unthinkable.
Bumper damage. Typical of Shanghai traffic.
So sorry. Entirely my fault. I do apologise.

seeded.note: Corporate ticket-closing in a tier-free line

lines.text: Front contact logged under policy 6.3; incident file opened; KPIs adjusted.
B2. I did not sign up for this.
Hit at 60 km/h. There goes my bonus.

seeded.note: a write-off line on an impact

lines.text: Written off. On my record. Unthinkable.

piece.title: The welcome wall
piece.tale: A conveyor sets you down beside a tower! Its screen shows your face and the word WELCOME! Farsight is pleased to have you! Your first duty is simple: stand in the road until a colleague notices you!

seeded.note: a power-up, enemies and a challenge

piece.title: The neon shops
piece.tale: The shops under the highway sell nothing. Their signs flash prices at the traffic. Hands 1 is your new power-up: place a cone and the enemy cars must stop. Win the challenge.

piece.intro: The river is a border; ships wait beyond it. Your papers are being prepared.

piece.label: Dash into a car, please
piece.brief: Dash into a car to finish the tile.

seeded.note: Waterfront B1 with the wrong equipment and duty

piece.title: The tunnel portal
piece.tale: The tunnel runs north under the hill to the next valley. Cars go in. Data comes back. Legs 1 is fitted. Push off one car into the next. Where your data goes is not within your role.

seeded.note: life and spawn point for chassis and bay

lines.text: Another life lost. Back to the spawn point.
This city was built so the fleet could certify.

piece.title: The podium bridge
piece.tale: Your first equipment has arrived: a battery, for the dash. The skybridge was built for shoppers who never came; staff now use it to watch the road. Today you join the road. Dash into a colleague. FARSIGHT will time you.

lines.text: The obelisk again. Of course it was me.
